name: grow-eco-system
description: GROW — Integrated Creative & Enterprise Infrastructure Operating as One. A unified monorepo: the GROW hub (marketing site + admin OS), Grow Engine (growth-intelligence platform), Growees Producer (recruitment engine), and shared brand + engine packages.
//workspaces: Only what production actually builds and runs. apps/engine-web and apps/producer are superseded by the /engine and /producer modules inside apps/grow; including them made `npm install` pull their dependency trees onto the server, which is where the critical Auth.js advisory and most of the other CVEs came from. apps/engine-worker stays — it is @growengine/worker, a direct hub dependency.

scripts.//build: Hostinger's configured output_directory is the repo-root `.next`. It must be a REAL directory: when it was a symlink to apps/grow/.next the host's post-build copy never populated the Passenger app root, so every deploy 'succeeded' while the site kept serving a months-old build. Copy, do not link.
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:hub && rm -rf .next && cp -R apps/grow/.next .next
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@growengine/db && npm run build --workspace=@growengine/core && npm run build --workspace=@growengine/worker
scripts.db:hub: npm run db:push --workspace=grow && npm run seed --workspace=grow
scripts.db:engine: npm run migrate --workspace=@growengine/db && npm run seed --workspace=@growengine/db
scripts.db:producer: npm run db:push --workspace=the-growees-producer && npm run db:seed:demo --workspace=the-growees-producer

//overrides: Security patches for transitive dependencies we do not control directly. Every entry stays inside the same major version so no API changes reach our code. brace-expansion, js-yaml, next, drizzle-orm and sharp are deliberately NOT pinned here: they need a major bump or are direct dependencies, so they get upgraded and tested on their own rather than silently forced.
